==Description==
'''Water The Plant''' emote is an emote that could be obtained at level 7 of the premium [[Ducky Revenge Event#Ducky Revenge Battle Pass|Ducky Revenge Battle Pass]]. It was made by StarWars and Fybirr. The emote is not looped, moveable or interactable. No music can be heard while performing this emote, though sounds can be heard.

When performed, the player will hold a watering can and water the ground, which will cause a sunflower to grow. This sunflower will last 10 seconds on the ground. The sunflower that was created will face the sun.

It had a cost of {{DuckyEggs|180}} or {{Robux|44}} ({{Robux|37}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale) to unlock it, with a total cost of {{DuckyEggs|700}} or {{Robux|366}} ({{Robux|308}} during the Memorial Day 2025 Sale).
